constraints: Keep the App Engine service runtime on an ID Google still supports; the service must be redeployed as a new version to change it.
Raising the runtime can require language and dependency changes; confirm the app runs on the replacement before shifting traffic.

steps.instructions: Set the runtime to a supported runtime ID (see the replacement) in app.yaml and in the Terraform google_app_engine_standard_app_version.
steps.title: Raise the App Engine runtime

steps.instructions: Deploy the change as a new version and move traffic to it after it serves correctly.
steps.title: Deploy a new version

verification.purpose: Initialize without touching remote state and check that the configuration is valid.
Review the plan and confirm the runtime change is the intended one.

sources.title: App Engine standard environment runtime support schedule

rules.summary: The App Engine standard environment runtime support schedule lists PHP 8.1 (runtime ID php81) with end of support on 2025-12-31 and deprecation on 2026-12-31. Google no longer provides patches or support for that runtime.
rules.title: App Engine PHP 8.1 runtime is past end of support
